summary: Tested unified Materials (single source of truth) across backend and frontend. 29/30 backend tests pass (1 skipped because no seeded paper product for /calc/paper). Frontend: central Materials page correctly renders 6 seeded demo materials, add/edit dialog conditionally shows Module Specs section per assigned module, save works. All 5 per-module material tabs (Large Format, Paper, Laser, Direct Print, Roll Stickers) are correctly read-only: no Add button, manage-link + readonly-note present, no edit/delete buttons. Per-module POST/PUT/DELETE endpoints return 400 with the expected message. Calculators pull from central materials (verified /calc/largeformat and /calc/sticker).

minor.issue: Could not exercise from tests because no default 'paper' product is seeded in the DB; test skips gracefully. Endpoint itself compiles and returns 422 for missing product_id which is correct behavior.

action_items: (Optional) Seed a default paper Product so /calc/paper can be smoke-tested by regression suites.
critical_code_review_comments: COLLECTION_MODULES + register_material_view design is clean: single source of truth in `materials` collection with module filtering for legacy per-module read endpoints, and 400 on writes. Good.
unify_materials_clean() is idempotent via db.migrations key; safe on redeploy.
map_material() applies sensible defaults (e.g. printable_width = roll_width - 2) so calculators don't crash on partially-filled central materials. Good.
server.py is ~2766 lines — approaching the 700-line threshold guideline; consider modularizing (materials, calc, catalog) for maintainability. Not blocking.
seed_data_creation: Created temporary TEST_UI_LF_Mat via UI (cleaned up) and TEST_LF_Banner_13oz via API fixture (cleaned up).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Unified Materials system verified end-to-end. To exercise /calc/paper next time, first POST a Product with module='paper' then feed its id + a paper stock id from /api/materials. Central materials collection is the source of truth; per-module endpoints (paper-stocks, roll-materials, laser-materials, sheet-materials, roll-sticker-materials) only expose GET (read from central) and return 400 for POST/PUT/DELETE.
